mapper.sql: SELECT 'EDHR_WORK_TASK' AS source_id, CONCAT('H',LPAD(CAST(h.id AS CHAR),20,'0')) AS row_order_key, CONCAT('handoff:',h.id) AS business_id, CONCAT('EDHR_WORK_TASK:handoff:',h.id) AS task_key, '批记录' AS task_type, 'eDHR工作任务' AS source, CONVERT(CONCAT(CASE h.task_type WHEN 'QA_REVIEW' THEN '请完成 QA 不合格评审' WHEN 'QA_DECISION_HANDOFF' THEN '请接手 QA 处置结果' ELSE '交接任务类型未识别，请核实任务数据' END, CHAR(10), '活跃订单编号：', h.active_order_id, '｜交接原因：', CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(h.reason), '') IS NULL THEN '交接原因缺失' ELSE TRIM(h.reason) END) USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS detail, CASE WHEN h.due_time IS NOT NULL AND h.due_time <= NOW() THEN '已超期·待接手' ELSE '待接手' END AS status_label, h.create_time AS created_at, h.due_time AS due_at, CONVERT(h.task_type USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS domain_task_type, CONVERT(h.action_url USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS action_url, NULL AS batch_execution_id, NULL AS batch_task_id, NULL AS execution_id, 'ACTIVE_ORDER_HANDOFF' AS business_scope_type, CAST(h.active_order_id AS CHAR) AS business_scope_id FROM mes_active_order_handoff_task h WHERE h.tenant_id=#{q.tenantId} AND h.deleted=0 AND h.task_type IN ('QA_DECISION_HANDOFF','QA_REVIEW') AND h.status='TODO' AND h.notification_only=0 AND FIND_IN_SET(#{q.userId},h.candidate_user_snapshot)>0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mes_pro_process_pool_active_order ao WHERE ao.id=h.active_order_id AND ao.tenant_id=h.tenant_id AND ao.deleted=0 AND ao.active_status='ACTIVE')
mapper.select: SELECT r.* FROM (SELECT r.* FROM () r ) r WHERE 1 = 1 LIMIT #{fetchLimit}
